_doc: The `verify-release` CLI (12 §1.3, F13) as its own workspace package, so its one dependency on @bleavit/verify is declared where it is used. The root package.json would have been simpler and wrong: pnpm's isolated node_modules is what makes an undeclared import unresolvable (see pnpm-workspace.yaml), and a root entry is reachable from every package by the parent-directory walk — which would quietly make @bleavit/verify importable from packages that never declared it.
name: @bleavit/verify-release
